title: brodiaea candida
intro: Brodiaea candida, commonly known as White Brodiaea, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asparagaceae family. It is known for its health benefits, which include the ability to support respiratory health and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of White Brodiaea include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to soothe and calm irritated tissues.
